mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notice (title, content, publisher_id, publish_time, read_count) VALUES (#{entity.title}, #{entity.content}, #{entity.publisherId}, #{entity.publishTime}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, content, publisher_id, publish_time, read_count FROM notice ORDER BY publish_time DESC

mapper.update: UPDATE notice SET read_count = read_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
